This was head coach [[Mike Davis (basketball coach)|Mike Davis]]'s fourth season at UAB. The Blazers competed in [[2009–10 Conference USA men's basketball season|Conference USA]] and played their home games at [[Bartow Arena]]. They finished the season 25–9, 11–5 in CUSA play and lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2010 Conference USA men's basketball tournament]].
